additional_info.subject: RE: ID0469606-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P8 170000885] Error: PowerMeterFailure CRM:02889000971
additional_info.body:
Dear Mr. Nicolas,
Good morning.
Thank you for raising the issue.
Unfortunately we can´t perform any remote troubleshooting when the SCB remains offline. Can you make sure the SCB online, please?
It is also important that the charger should not in use condition to do remote troubleshooting.
Thirdly, did you tried to reboot the charger please?
Let me know  all those 3 answers please.
Waiting for your valuable response.
I wish you an early happy New year.
Mit Freundlichen Grüßen/ Melhores Cumprimentos/ Best Regards
Harun Ar Rashid
Technical Support Specialist (eMobility)
Av. 25 de Abril 201, 2845-547, Corroios, Portugal.
Email: harun.ar-rashid.ext@siemens.com

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0469606-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P8 170000885] Error: PowerMeterFailure CRM:02889000971
additional_info.body:
Dear Mr. Nicolas,
I hope you are doing well. After remote troubleshooting all the outlets are error free.  The charger is in operation now.
Please let me know if I can close the ticket.
There is an update available. It is always recommended that the charger should run with latest FW version to avoid such type of bug issues in future.
Mit Freundlichen Grüßen/ Melhores Cumprimentos/ Best Regards
